notes: Rise (RISE) is a community meme token implemented by src/Rise.sol using the vendored OpenZeppelin ERC20. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals once to msg.sender, the deployer. Transfers are plain ERC-20 transfers with no token fees. There is no post-launch minting, owner privilege over user funds, upgradeability, or blacklist. No application contracts or initialization calls are requested. The requested launch allocation is 90% of the total supply to liquidity and zero tokens to the creator wallet. Pool defaults are fee 3000 (0.3% on pool trades) and tick spacing 60. The paired currency is the exact ERC-20 address supplied in the request. initialMarketCapWei is denominated in that paired currency's minor units. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(2^96 * sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply)), quoted with RISE as currency0 and the paired currency as currency1. The deployer derives the actual opening price from economics and totalSupply using the deployed currencies' address ordering. Community reference supplied by the requester: https://x.com/surfcoderepeat/status/2107650558039658980.
